column1: # 主词目|独立例句|中文译文|可选发音文本
crosswind shear|The crew reported crosswind shear on final approach.|机组报告最后进近时遭遇侧风切变。
damage to aircraft|The inspection revealed damage to aircraft parked near the hangar.|检查发现机库附近停放的航空器受损。
external part of aircraft|The damaged panel is an external part of aircraft structure.|受损面板属于航空器结构的外部部件。
fog is coming down|Fog is coming down over the airfield.|雾正在笼罩机场。
get struck|An aircraft can get struck by lightning in a storm.|航空器在雷暴中可能遭到雷击。
headwind shear|Headwind shear caused a rapid change in indicated airspeed.|顶风切变导致指示空速迅速变化。
dial|The pointer on the dial did not move.|表盘上的指针没有移动。
radio contact lost|With radio contact lost, the crew followed the published procedure.|无线电联系中断后，机组遵循了公布的程序。
snowflake|Each snowflake melted on the warm windshield.|每片雪花落到温暖的风挡上就融化了。
state flight|Special arrangements were made for the state flight.|有关方面为该专机飞行作了特别安排。
tailwind shear|The sudden tailwind shear reduced the aircraft's airspeed.|突然出现的顺风切变使航空器空速下降。
anti-icing system inoperative|The crew reported the anti-icing system inoperative.|机组报告防冰系统不工作。
gear appears down|From the tower, the gear appears down.|从塔台观察，起落架看上去已放下。
establish visual contact|The pilot was unable to establish visual contact with the traffic.|飞行员未能与该航空器建立目视接触。
bird scaring in progress|Bird scaring in progress near the runway delayed the departure.|跑道附近正在进行驱鸟作业，离场因此延误。
bog down|Heavy vehicles may bog down on soft ground.|重型车辆可能陷入松软地面。
brakes are unreliable|The pilot reported that the brakes are unreliable.|飞行员报告刹车工作不可靠。
chop the engines|The expression "chop the engines" means to cut engine power abruptly.|“chop the engines”表示突然切断发动机动力。
control stand|The throttle levers are mounted on the control stand.|推力杆安装在操纵台上。
control system inoperative|The warning showed the flight control system inoperative.|警告显示飞行操纵系统不工作。
engine is low on power|The pilot reported that the engine is low on power.|飞行员报告发动机动力不足。
number one engine failure|The crew declared an emergency after a number one engine failure.|一号发动机失效后，机组宣布了紧急状态。
engine runs roughly|The engineer noted that the engine runs roughly at idle.|工程师注意到发动机在慢车状态下运转不平稳。
flight navigation control panel|The pilot checked the settings on the flight navigation control panel.|飞行员检查了飞行导航控制面板上的设置。
runway foaming|Runway foaming was discussed during the emergency response briefing.|应急处置简报讨论了跑道铺泡沫事宜。
fog is clearing up|The fog is clearing up, and visibility is improving.|雾正在消散，能见度正在改善。
interrupt communication|A stuck microphone can interrupt communication on the frequency.|卡住的话筒可能干扰该频率上的通信。
runway stop end|The aircraft came to rest near the runway stop end.|航空器最终停在跑道末端附近。
select emergency fuel|The checklist instructed the crew to select emergency fuel supply.|检查单指示机组选择应急燃油供给。
standby instrument|The pilot cross-checked the failed display against a standby instrument.|飞行员利用备用仪表交叉核对失效显示器的信息。
increase thrust|The pilot had to increase thrust to maintain the selected airspeed.|飞行员需要增加推力，以保持选定空速。
traffic no longer a factor|The controller advised, "Traffic no longer a factor."|管制员通报：“该交通已不再构成影响。”
blocked transmission|The blocked transmission prevented the pilot from hearing the clearance.|发话被阻塞，飞行员未能听到管制许可。
feathered propeller|The feathered propeller produced less drag after the engine shutdown.|发动机关闭后，已顺桨的螺旋桨产生的阻力较小。
low-pressure compressor|The inspection found damage to the low-pressure compressor.|检查发现低压压气机受损。
occasional shower|An occasional shower reduced visibility along the coast.|沿岸偶有阵雨，能见度有所下降。
acrid|An acrid smell came from the electrical panel.|电气面板散发出刺鼻气味。
capacitor|The technician replaced a damaged capacitor in the power unit.|技术员更换了电源装置中一个损坏的电容器。
clearway|The chart shows a clearway beyond the departure end of the runway.|航图标出了跑道离场端以外的净空道。
climbout|The crew noticed an unusual vibration during climbout.|机组在起飞爬升阶段察觉到异常振动。
conductor|A damaged conductor interrupted the electrical supply.|受损的导体导致供电中断。
crossbleed|The crew checked the crossbleed valve position.|机组检查了交输引气活门的位置。
crossfeed|The crossfeed valve allows fuel to pass between the supply lines.|交输活门允许燃油在供油管路之间流通。
deform|Excessive heat can deform the panel.|过热可能使面板变形。
dent|The inspection revealed a dent in the leading edge.|检查发现前缘有一处凹痕。
frostbite|The rescue team treated the passenger for frostbite.|救援队为旅客治疗冻伤。
inductor|The circuit contains an inductor and a capacitor.|该电路包含一个电感器和一个电容器。
injector|A blocked injector caused uneven fuel delivery.|喷嘴堵塞导致燃油供给不均。
loadmaster|The loadmaster checked the cargo restraints before departure.|装载员在起飞前检查了货物固定装置。
pilotage|The pilot used pilotage to identify the route by visible landmarks.|飞行员采用地标领航，通过可见地标辨认路线。
rib|A cracked wing rib was found during the structural inspection.|结构检查中发现一根翼肋出现裂纹。
subside|The crew waited for the strong winds to subside.|机组等待强风减弱。
transient|A transient voltage spike triggered the warning.|一次瞬态电压尖峰触发了警告。
airstrip|The small aircraft landed on a remote grass airstrip.|小型飞机降落在偏远的草地简易跑道上。
relight|The crew attempted an engine relight.|机组尝试使发动机重新点火。
anvil|The thunderstorm had a broad anvil at its top.|该雷暴云顶部呈宽阔的砧状。
blizzard|The blizzard brought strong winds and blowing snow.|暴风雪带来了强风和风吹雪。
deplete|Repeated start attempts can deplete the battery.|反复尝试启动可能耗尽电瓶电量。
electromechanical|The electromechanical actuator failed to move the valve.|机电作动器未能带动活门运动。
excreta|The ground team handled the waste containing human excreta.|地面人员处理了含人体排泄物的废物。
floodlight|A floodlight illuminated the aircraft parking area.|一盏泛光灯照亮了航空器停放区域。
insidious|Fatigue can have an insidious effect on judgment.|疲劳可能以不易察觉的方式影响判断。
stagger|The controller had to stagger the departures to maintain spacing.|管制员需要错开离场时间，以保持间隔。
uncommanded|The crew reported an uncommanded roll to the left.|机组报告航空器在没有操纵指令的情况下向左滚转。
hypobaric|The trainees learned about hypobaric conditions in a low-pressure chamber.|学员在低压舱中了解了低气压环境。
gust front|The gust front reached the airport before the main storm.|阵风锋先于雷暴主体到达机场。
taildragger|The taildragger has a small wheel beneath the tail.|这架后三点式起落架飞机在尾部下方装有一个小轮。
explosive decompression|The crew practiced responding to explosive decompression in the simulator.|机组在模拟机中练习处置爆炸性失压。
resequence|ATC had to resequence the arriving aircraft.|空管需要重新安排进场航空器的次序。
ambiguity|The controller repeated the instruction to remove any ambiguity.|管制员重复了指令，以消除歧义。
combust|Fuel can combust when mixed with air and exposed to an ignition source.|燃油与空气混合并接触点火源时可能燃烧。
disorient|Poor visibility can disorient an inexperienced pilot.|低能见度可能使经验不足的飞行员迷失方向。
glitch|A brief software glitch interrupted the display.|一次短暂的软件故障导致显示中断。
hypoxic|The passenger became hypoxic after the oxygen supply failed.|供氧失效后，旅客出现了缺氧。
isolation|The crew confirmed the isolation of the faulty electrical bus.|机组确认已隔离故障汇流条。
jetliner|The jetliner returned to its departure airport.|该喷气客机返回了起飞机场。
rotor|The technician inspected the rotor for damage.|技术员检查了转子是否受损。
shortness of breath|The passenger complained of chest pain and shortness of breath.|旅客诉说胸痛并感到气短。
steerable|The aircraft has a steerable nosewheel.|该航空器装有可转向的前轮。
unambiguous|The clearance must be clear and unambiguous.|管制许可必须清晰且无歧义。
unscheduled|An unscheduled maintenance inspection delayed the flight.|一次计划外维修检查导致航班延误。
MSL|The chart gives the elevation in feet above MSL.|航图以高于平均海平面的英尺数标示标高。
AAIB|The AAIB published a report on the accident.|英国航空事故调查局公布了事故报告。
EASA|The document refers to an EASA airworthiness directive.|该文件引用了一项欧盟航空安全局的适航指令。
UHF|The aircraft was equipped with a UHF radio.|该航空器配备了一部特高频无线电台。
SAT|The display shows SAT separately from total air temperature.|显示器将静温与总温分别显示。
warm front|The warm front brought widespread low cloud.|暖锋带来了大范围低云。
non-radar separation|The controller applied non-radar separation.|管制员采用了非雷达间隔。
air-driven booster pump|The air-driven booster pump supplies additional pressure.|气动增压泵提供额外压力。
high-pressure compressor|The high-pressure compressor was removed for inspection.|高压压气机被拆下检查。
decrease thrust|The pilot had to decrease thrust during the descent.|飞行员在下降过程中需要减小推力。
bird and animal hazard|The airport team assessed the bird and animal hazard near the runway.|机场人员评估了跑道附近的鸟类及动物危害。
engine runs smoothly|The engineer confirmed that the engine runs smoothly.|工程师确认发动机运转平稳。
gear appears up|From the observation point, the gear appears up.|从观察点看，起落架似乎已收上。
compel|The fuel situation may compel the crew to divert.|燃油状况可能迫使机组备降。
force|The crew had to force the jammed door open.|机组不得不用力打开卡住的门。
experience|The aircraft may experience turbulence during the descent.|航空器在下降过程中可能遭遇颠簸。
ablaze|The maintenance vehicle was ablaze when the firefighters arrived.|消防员到达时，维修车辆正在燃烧。
accessory|The technician inspected the engine accessory drive.|技术员检查了发动机附件传动装置。
causal|The investigators identified several causal factors.|调查人员确定了若干致因因素。
concise|The captain gave a clear and concise briefing.|机长作了清晰简洁的简报。
crease|The damaged panel had a deep crease near its edge.|受损面板靠近边缘处有一道深折痕。
diminish|The turbulence began to diminish after the aircraft left the cloud.|航空器飞出云层后，颠簸开始减弱。
dispersal|The airport used bird dispersal measures near the runway.|机场在跑道附近采取了驱鸟措施。
douse|The firefighters used water to douse the flames.|消防员用水浇灭火焰。
embark|Passengers were waiting to embark on the aircraft.|旅客正在等待登机。
ensue|Further delays may ensue if the storm reaches the airport.|如果雷暴到达机场，可能会接着出现更多延误。
feasible|The crew considered whether a return to the airport was feasible.|机组考虑返回机场是否可行。
freight|The aircraft was carrying freight rather than passengers.|该航空器运输的是货物，而非旅客。
incompatible|The replacement component was incompatible with the installed system.|替换部件与已安装的系统不兼容。
nauseous|The passenger felt nauseous during the turbulence.|旅客在颠簸中感到恶心。
neglect|Pilots must not neglect the effect of fatigue on performance.|飞行员不能忽视疲劳对表现的影响。
perceive|The pilot could not perceive the runway slope in the darkness.|飞行员在黑暗中无法察觉跑道坡度。
premature|A premature rotation can affect takeoff performance.|过早抬轮可能影响起飞性能。
restraint|The loadmaster checked each cargo restraint.|装载员检查了每一处货物约束装置。
shiver|The rescued passenger began to shiver in the cold wind.|获救旅客在寒风中开始发抖。
solder|The technician used solder to repair the electrical connection.|技术员用焊料修复了电气连接。
succession|The crew heard three loud bangs in quick succession.|机组接连听到了三声巨响。
supersede|The new bulletin will supersede the previous instructions.|新通报将取代先前的指示。
